title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES EXTENDING FURTHER THE DURATION OF OPERATIONS OF THE PRESIDENTIAL MIDDLE EAST PREPAREDNESS COMMXTTEE (PMEPC) TO JUNE 30, 2007

text.en:
Function -
The PMEPC shall continue to exercise its
functions and responsibilities as provided under Executive Order No. 159 dated

December 23, 2002, in relation to Executive Order No. 194 and Executive Order
No. 195, both dated April 14, 2003, until June 30, 2007.

Composition - The membership of the Committee, as
enumerated under Section 3 of Executive Order No. 159, as amended by
Executive Order No. 549, is further expanded to include one representative from
the Bureau of Immigration.

Funding - The Committee shall be provided an additional
funding allocation of FIVE MILLION PESOS (Php5,000,000.00) for Its
administrative and operational expenses to be provided by the Office of the
President. Aciditional financial requirements that may be needed by tie
Committee shall be sourced out by the Department of Budget and Management
(OBM) from available fonds of the concerned agencies forming part of the
PMEPC, subject to the usual govemment accounting and auditing rules and
regulations.

Repeal - All other rules, regulations and issuances or
parts thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity - This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 12 tiday of
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Seven.
Mornin thro. Always
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
